text: 🍿 Blade Runner 2099 hands the world to the replicants 📆 Release: November 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #SciFi · #Drama ✈️ Add to watchlist The new trailer shows a world where replicants have won and are now stuck with the same questions about identity and mortality. Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer lead eight episodes on Prime Video, set 50 years after 2049. Flipping the power balance is the smart move. 'Blade Runner' always asked what makes a person, and a society run by the made rather than the makers gives that question room a two-hour film never had. You don't need to have seen 'Blade Runner' to follow it, but the rain-soaked melancholy only lands if the show earns it and doesn't just borrow the neon.

🍿 The Exorcist: Martyrs puts Scarlett Johansson in the devil's crosshairs 📆 Release: March 12, 2027 🎭 Genre: #Horror · #Thriller ✈️ Add to watchlist Mike Flanagan is finally getting his Exorcist, and /Film says the trailer swerves from the franchise's usual dread. Scarlett Johansson plays an NYPD detective chasing a killer who calls himself Father Sunday. That makes it a procedural first and a possession story second. It's a smart way in after sequels that kept trying to out-scare Friedkin. Flanagan has the tools, from the chamber-piece tension of 'Hush' to a gift for grief and faith. If the film honors the ritual and doesn't treat it as a gimmick, this could be the best thing the series has done in decades.
